tagline: Speak any language without the fear
brief: An AI speaking-practice app for 16 languages (any language to any language), with flashcard decks built from your mistakes. For people who freeze when they have to speak. It should feel calm, friendly and confident, never like school. The mascot is Rio, a sea otter.
criteria: Success: owns the otter (no owls, globes or flags), reads at 16 px, works in one colour, and the name hides a face (ri-ovo-x).

concepts.name: Rio bubble
concepts.idea: Rio's head is a speech bubble; the coral tail is its voice.

concepts.name: Rio floating
concepts.idea: Rio floats on its back holding a flashcard, like real sea otters.
rationale: Otter + deck + river (rio) in one picture
Calm, the opposite of speaking anxiety
No language app has anything like it

concepts.name: Rio in the river
concepts.idea: Rio rises out of the river; the ripples spread like a voice.
rationale: Bold, friendly face for the app icon

recommendation: Rio floating as the main logo and app icon, with its head-on-water cut for tiny sizes. It tells the whole story and is the most ownable.
next_steps: Replace the app and website icons
Trademark search for Riovox and the mark
